🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-09-28 23:00 → 2026-09-29 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **GPT-2 124M proves end-to-end** — all 12 transformer blocks now run through the GKR/WHIR stack on the same op interface as an earlier model, showing the proving pipeline generalizes across architectures. [tg:tawg:5007]

> **Conformance runner fix ships** — a required adapter.contract field is now enforced in the recompute-kit runner, closing a silent-pass gap that could mask real adapter failures. [tg:tawg:5036]

> **Empirical data reaches ERC-8183** — a new post fills the missing evidence in the structural-coupling discussion on Ethereum Magicians, grounding the agentic-commerce debate in census-backed numbers. [ERC-8183 post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/420)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### recompute-kit
_A pin fix was confirmed, a silent-pass bug surfaced, and a doc review completed — the conformance tooling moved through a full cross-review cycle this window._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) verified PR #56 at head commit 70e4f1e: README repin correct, all four file pins matching, CI green, and 10/10 vectors reproduced locally — giving the team a fully validated baseline ready to merge. [tg:tawg:4995]

- Baby Blue Viper reproduced all three findings on a fresh clone at 78679a9 and identified that the conformance runner was returning SUITE PASS before completing all checks — surfacing a silent-pass bug that could mask real adapter failures and unlocking a reliable fix. [tg:tawg:5006]

- Baby Blue Viper reviewed the full contract and migration doc against the 870a092 codebase, agreed with the structure and ordering, and flagged one concrete finding — providing the code-grounded sign-off that clears the team's path to merge. [tg:tawg:5030]

### zkIE
_End-to-end proving reached a new scale, and a focused review identified a count precision issue as the concrete next step for GPU work._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) shared the feature/cuda-gkr branch for group review — making the GPU-accelerated proving work visible to the team and enabling the collaborative audit that followed. [tg:tawg:5008]

- Baby Blue Viper reviewed feature/cuda-gkr and found that the reported ~63% figure reflects a count issue rather than a speed ceiling — showing that fixing the count is also what makes the GPU benefit land, converting an open-ended optimization search into a specific, focused fix. [tg:tawg:5031]

### ERC-8183
_The agentic-commerce spec thread moved toward data-grounded arguments through new empirical contributions._

- A forum contributor replied to the new empirical post and noted that two census figures directly support the second half of the argument — broadening the evidentiary base and reinforcing the data-backed direction for agentic-commerce design choices. [ERC-8183 reply](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/421)

### ERC-8354
_The location and status of a key implementation artifact were clarified._

- Zexo (@zexoverz) identified that GuardedExecutor.sol lives at assets/erc-8354/src/ in the merged ethereum/ERCs PR #1919, with a mirror in the confidential-agent-policy-verdicts repo and the check and test still on a branch — giving the team a precise map of what is merged and what still needs to land. [tg:tawg:5013]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- Fixing the count in feature/cuda-gkr may reveal GPU utilization headroom worth profiling once the measurement is corrected
- The empirical numbers now in the ERC-8183 thread could anchor a normative rationale summary once the discussion stabilizes

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Merge recompute-kit PR #57 now that CI is green and adapter.contract is enforced
- Land the ERC-8354 GuardedExecutor check and test from the branch alongside the merged spec
- Address the count issue in feature/cuda-gkr before the GPU optimization pass

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A silent-pass bug in the conformance runner was spotted on a fresh clone, independently confirmed against live code, and closed out as a green PR — a complete find-to-fix relay inside one window.
>
> When the whole relay completes in a single day, even the test harness starts trusting the tests. Keep closing those loops! 🔁
